annotation_review.conversion: axis-aligned enclosing rectangles; polygon shape discarded

visual_review: Nine contact sheets covering all 691 retained images; meal contents generally match food-class annotations. Partial hands and tableware/packaging marks are visible in some images; no identifiable faces seen in the reviewed sheets.
student_use: Food category detection as a prototype for making cafeteria menus more visible or exploring food variety. Source is one university cafeteria in Bangladesh; not representative of Japanese meals, nutrition, allergy, hygiene, price, or food-waste measurements.
verification: Both used Mendeley files were checked against their published SHA-256 values and sizes before extraction. ZIP CRC passed; selected 691 image/label pairs match; all 16 class IDs are valid. The prepared ZIP CRC passes and its manifest lists every packaged file with SHA-256 and size.
